summary: security checked in 1 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. TLS evidence shows only that no certificates expire within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not proof of compromise. Risk severity is high for public exposure and medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: continue existing bounded read-only security evidence work, preserve unknowns, retain private launch gates, and create no new proposal, change request, requeue, deployment, permission change, credential change, configuration change, dependency addition, telemetry request, or external outreach.
